correctness.rationale: Derivative of Q with respect to (a,b,c,d,e) is (d^2,cd,bd,bc,b^2), so singular support is (b,d) and D is irreducible nonnormal. Substitution of [su:sw:tu+sv:tw:tv] into Q is zero, over (b,d)!=0 [s:t]=[b:d] recovers normalization parameter; projectivity plus finite quadratic fibers yields finite birational P1xP2 normalization. On affine chart a=1, put d=b lambda with lambda^2+c lambda+e=0; R=A+bA lambda has conductor bB=(b,d) with B=A[lambda]. On w=0 inverse conductor C maps to P by [su:tu+sv:tv] = quadratic unordered-pair quotient. Its diagonal [s:t]=[u:v] maps to [s^2:0:t^2] by Frobenius. Generic repeated root r^2=d/b is a nonsquare of rational function field and so degree-two purely inseparable. Counting P1xP2 minus P1xP1 plus P2 gives q^3+2q^2+q+1. Independent GF(2^m) projective enumeration for q=2,4,8 gave exactly 19,101,649; finite counts only corroborate algebraic all-q proof.
